name: Tokiwa Sumika
source:
"I'm Sumika Tokiwa! Chief programmer at Iris Corporation. Mai is better than me as a programmer. But as chief, I'm doing my best to keep the team running smoothly! Until [url=/c160592]Arata[/url] comes back to Iris Corp, I'll keep pushing forward!"

A lead at Iris Corporation who oversees all the programmers.

Though her programming skills don't match up to [url=/c160574]Mai's[/url], her management skills greatly contribute to the company. Her attention to detail and ability to juggle schedules is top-class. When [url=/c160573]Shiina[/url] isn't feeling well, Sumika even steps in as acting director. [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] ends up relying on her soon after joining Iris Corp.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category1&ch=sumika]official website[/url]]
